title: Explain a Community Event Plan

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a fictional team about a small performance. Describe the venue, two preparations, the order of events and something that still needs to be done. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先介绍活动时间与场地；再写表演和准备事项；最后说明尚需完成的任务。尝试情态被动和 need to be，并使用至少六个目标词。

reference: Our fictional festival will take place in a small community hall on Friday evening. The venue has thirty chairs for the audience, and the admission price will be shown on the invitation. First, a singer and a band will perform one song. A guest will then play the violin, and a volunteer will announce the next part of the programme. The microphone must be checked before the rehearsal, and the stage is being cleaned today. A banner also needs to be made for the entrance. We can invite neighbors, but we should ask them to sign up so that the crowd does not block the door. After the concert, the audience can applaud and talk with the performers. Finally, we will return the chairs and leave the room ready for the next group.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
